entities.name: The Fifth Dawn
entities.description: An event around 4400 AR on Mirrodin in which a fifth, green sun was born, leading to the collapse of Memnarch's rule.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial plane, formerly known as Argentum, ruled by Memnarch.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The corrupted creator of Mirrodin who succumbed to delusions of godhood and sought to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: An elf of the Tangle whose grief-driven surge of green mana birthed the fifth sun; her spark remained untriggered.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A clever goblin tinkerer who resisted Memnarch alongside Glissa.

entities.name: Bosh
entities.description: An ancient golem caught in Memnarch's web who resisted him.

entities.name: Malil
entities.description: Memnarch's assistant construct, maimed when the green beam struck the Panopticon.

entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Glissa's sister, who believed Glissa responsible for the deaths of their parents; the green sun was later named after her.

entities.name: Lyese (green sun)
entities.description: The fifth, green sun of Mirrodin, named by Glissa in memory of her sister; the Sylvok call it the True Sun and the Oxidda goblins the Ugly Child.

entities.name: Kaldra
entities.description: A powerful, corrupted avatar Memnarch turned against his foes; annihilated by the green mana surge.

entities.name: The Panopticon
entities.description: The device in Mirrodin's Core through which Memnarch channeled the plane's mana to attempt ascension.

entities.name: Mirrodin's Core
entities.description: The heart of Mirrodin where Memnarch channeled the plane's mana.

entities.name: The Tangle
entities.description: The green region of Mirrodin where Glissa was from and where the trolls sacrificed themselves.

entities.name: The Radix
entities.description: A node of green mana in the Tangle, from which the fifth sun emerged.

entities.name: The Bringer
entities.description: The white mana-infused satellite orbiting Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Eye of Doom
entities.description: The blue mana-infused satellite orbiting Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Ingle
entities.description: The black mana-infused satellite orbiting Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Sky Tyrant
entities.description: The red mana-infused satellite orbiting Mirrodin.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: The substance that corrupted Memnarch and made him lose his original purpose.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: Mirrodin inhabitants who call the green sun the True Sun.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain goblins
entities.description: Goblins who mockingly call the green sun the Ugly Child.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves who captured Glissa and Slobad, many blaming Glissa for the disappearance of their kin.

entities.name: Trolls of the Tangle
entities.description: Trolls who sacrificed themselves to delay Kaldra.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The horror Mirrodin later became.

events.summary: Memnarch, corrupted by Phyrexian oil, seeds Mirrodin with four mana-infused satellites and captures beings from across the Multiverse to seek planeswalker ascension.
events.quote: Memnarch began capturing beings from across the Multiverse through arcane soul traps

events.summary: Glissa, Slobad and Bosh resist Memnarch and confront him in the Core, where he channels the plane's mana through the Panopticon.
events.quote: Their resistance culminated in a confrontation deep within Mirrodin's Core

events.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
events.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

events.summary: The trolls of the Tangle sacrifice themselves to delay Kaldra.
events.quote: the trolls of the Tangle sacrificed themselves to delay Kaldra

events.summary: Believing Slobad dead, Glissa triggers a surge of green mana that destroys Kaldra and births the green sun, the Fifth Dawn.
events.quote: annihilated Kaldra, and shot into the sky, birthing a new sun

events.summary: The beam strikes the Panopticon, severely damaging it and maiming Memnarch and Malil, shattering Memnarch's ascension plans.
events.quote: Memnarch’s dream of planeswalker ascension was shattered

events.summary: The new sun joins the orbit of the four satellites, disrupting their paths for five years, and mutates the wildlife of the Tangle.
events.quote: causing five years of instability in the heavens

events.summary: Glissa and Slobad are captured by Viridian elves who blame Glissa for vanishing kin.
events.quote: Glissa and Slobad were captured by Viridian elves

relations.note: Memnarch seeded the plane with four satellites and ruled it.
relations.quote: Memnarch had seeded the plane with four orbiting mana-infused satellites

relations.note: Glissa and her allies resisted him.
relations.quote: Their resistance culminated in a confrontation deep within Mirrodin's Core

relations.note: They fled together to the Tangle.
relations.quote: Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle
Among them was Glissa’s sister, Lyese
